timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I'll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you'll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let's begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I feel nervous about what's ahead.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My body is bracing for something.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: It's okay that I feel this way right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I don't need to feel calm to move forward.
I can let some of this nervous energy settle.
I've gotten through nervous moments before.
I can take one steady breath before I begin.
I don't have to be perfect, just present.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I'm ready to meet this moment as I am.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Let that stay with you.
